note: read_group/format.py cleared: 1293 -> 1287. All six came from _read_group_format_result and all six are one root cause -- three names each holding two types, which is what made the block unanalysable rather than any runtime fault. additional_domain starts as a list of (field, op, value) triples and is later reassigned to a Domain literal that prepends the "&" operator, so no inferred element type could ever fit both; it is now declared `list`. range_start/range_end held a date and then their own strftime output, so one name was a date on one line and a str three lines down; the serialised forms are now range_start_str/range_end_str. And isinstance(value, (datetime.date, datetime.datetime)) narrowed to plain date -- datetime is a SUBCLASS of date, so the tuple never admitted anything its first member did not -- while the code below called .replace(tzinfo=)/.astimezone(), which only datetime carries. That is safe at runtime because field.type decides which arrives, not the isinstance; the check is now the honest isinstance(value, datetime.date), with the datetime invariant asserted where it is relied on -- the shape the Many2many._relation_columns note describes: state the real invariant once and assert it. No behaviour change intended or observed. These six were invisible until the 2.3.0 bump one commit earlier, and are the first concrete return on it.
